title: Enterprise Connectivity: billable volume increment
content:
## Tier basis
Enterprise Connectivity uses the following billable volume increment for each named contract tier. Smallest billable primary meter increment in primary consumption unit; positive decimal.

## Tier comparison
| Contract tier | Facet | Value |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 250 Mbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 500 Mbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 1 Gbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 2 Gbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |
| Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 5 Gbps | billable volume increment | 0.000001 (1e-06) |

## Basis Q&A
For the Northbridge Enterprise Connectivity 100 Mbps tier, the billable volume increment is 0.000001 (1e-06).
